notes:
New: Script tab in the FDL editor. Paste settings as text, one per line (NAME=werte=01), and each line is checked against the open file. Apply sets them all at once, with Undo. A name that is not in this version gets the closest names shown.
New: choose which PSdZData each E-Sys loads, right above the Launch button (the packs on this PC, or any folder).
The Launch E-Sys button stays in view with many cars in the garage.
Updating no longer asks you to close E-Sys that another program started.
